name: RMA Global Limited
summary: RMA Global Limited, an online digital marketing company, provides data on real estate. The company offers sale results for residential real estate agents and agencies, as well as reviews of agent performance from vendors and buyers of residential real estate. It operates in Australia, the United States, and New Zealand. The company was formerly known as Digital Castle Pty. Ltd. RMA Global Limited was founded in 2014 and is based in Cremorne, Australia.
